text:
Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of a computer or machine to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. Machine learning is a key part of AI where computers learn from data without being explicitly programmed. A more advanced form is deep learning, which uses layers of artificial neural networks to process complex information, like recognizing faces or understanding speech.

You already encounter AI in daily life. For example, streaming services recommend shows based on what you watch, and virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa answer your questions. Self-driving cars and smart home devices also rely on AI. While still developing, AI continues to become more integrated into how we live and work.
